$comment: Tinctures (design §5, Apothecary — v1.1): buff consumables brewed at the fire from marsh goods. Drinking one spends a single unit of camp stock and grants its effects for durationSec of played time (live or offline catch-up — the clock is sim time, not wall time); drinking again while active ADDS the full duration on top of what's left — the clock stacks, the effect never does. Effects use the shared effect vocabulary and join the run's active-effect union while live. id must match a recipe output (the brew is the acquisition path; tinctures are materials — never sold, never traded); description is the bottle's own line in the HUD. Durations and brew costs set by the zones 4-6 balance pass: 1200 s is one drink per sitting rather than a ten-minute nag, and the tripled inputs (recipes.json) make a bottle read as a real brew in the stock ledger without ever gating it — at marsh-era gather rates even the tripled bundle is under a minute of a posted familiar. Effect sizes are still first guesses (todo.md).

tinctures.name: Warden's Tonic
tinctures.description: steadies the hands: +25% gathering while it lasts

tinctures.name: Glow Salve
tinctures.description: lights the watching: observation sites half again as quick

tinctures.name: Peat-Smoke Draught
tinctures.description: slows the breath: every craft half again as quick
